name: tabby-select
description: Development and test tooling for the TabbySelect browser extension.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:package && npm run test:e2e:package
scripts.test:package: node scripts/build-store-packages.mjs --output dist/store-packages --firefox-id tabby-select@tests.invalid && NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 web-ext lint --warnings-as-errors --source-dir dist/store-packages/firefox
